newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.04 pct in commercial trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.04 pct in commercial trade.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.04 percent to close at 1.0646 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market following the Central Bank's lowering of the reais-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The Central Bank confirmed market expectations by lowering the mini-band Tuesday for the first time this month by 0.09 percent to between 1.0645 and 1.0695 reais per dollar.
The previous mini-band was set on April 30 at between 1.0635 and 1.0685 per dollar.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real dropped 0.1 percent to 1.0696 per dollar.
In the parallel market, the real fell 0.44 percent to close at 1.135 per dollar, traders said.
